resources.string: Merge duplicate categories and their records
Select categories to merge, then choose the category to keep. Income and expense categories stay separate.
Future entries using an old category will use the category you keep.
Updates %1$d transactions and %2$d recurring items, including future installments.
Balances and amounts stay unchanged. Old categories disappear from selection; category budget limits are added together. Check the destination carefully; this merge cannot be automatically undone.
